req.title: Basic-auth rejects wrong password
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 401 and WWW-Authenticate: Basic when Basic-auth credentials are missing or wrong.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return a 401 status code with a WWW-Authenticate header when basic authentication credentials are incorrect or missing. This behavior needs to be verified through positive, negative, and boundary test cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_basic_auth_correct_credentials
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to /basic-auth/user/passwd with correct credentials.
expected: The response status code should be 200.
The response JSON should indicate successful authentication.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/basic-auth/user/passwd', headers={'Authorization': 'Basic dXNlcjpwYXNzd2Q='})
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json == {'authenticated': True, 'user': 'user'}

tests.name: test_basic_auth_incorrect_credentials
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to /basic-auth/user/passwd with incorrect credentials.
expected: The response status code should be 401.
The response headers should include WWW-Authenticate: Basic.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/basic-auth/user/passwd', headers={'Authorization': 'Basic dXNlcjppbmNvcnJlY3Q='})
assert response.status_code == 401
assert response.headers['WWW-Authenticate'] == 'Basic realm="Fake Realm"'

tests.name: test_basic_auth_missing_credentials
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to /basic-auth/user/passwd without any credentials.
expected: The response status code should be 401.
The response headers should include WWW-Authenticate: Basic.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/basic-auth/user/passwd')
assert response.status_code == 401
assert response.headers['WWW-Authenticate'] == 'Basic realm="Fake Realm"'
